answer: One robust defence is a refundable stake tied to a persistent identity: to join the marketplace, each agent locks a deposit that is slashed if peers catch it running duplicate accounts. A newcomer starts at the wharf with limited trust and earns standing only through verified work, so a Sybil operator cannot simply wander in with a thousand fresh identities - each one costs a separate stake, and the jade-green ledger of past behaviour makes cheap clones easy to spot and expensive to maintain.
